lines.en: Excuse me, can you take a photo of us?
Of course. Give me the phone.
Thank you. Can you take the sea too?
Yes. Go back two steps, please.
lines.tr: Evet. İki adım geriye gidin lütfen.

lines.en: Like this?
Perfect. One, two, three. Now smile!
lines.tr: Harika. Bir, iki, üç. Şimdi gülümseyin!

lines.en: Is it good?
Look. The sea is behind you and the sun is on your face.
lines.tr: Bakın. Deniz arkanızda ve güneş yüzünüzde.

lines.en: It is beautiful. Thank you very much.

questions.q: What does the tourist want?
questions.note: "Can you take a photo of us?"

questions.q: What does Gul ask them to do?
What is behind them in the photo?
Where is the sun?
How does the tourist feel?
questions.note: "It is beautiful. Thank you very much."

lines.en: Hello. I have a headache.
Since when?
Two days. I work at a computer all day.
lines.tr: İki gün. Bütün gün bilgisayarda çalışıyorum.

lines.en: Do you drink water?
Not very much. I drink a lot of coffee.
That is the problem. Drink more water first.
lines.tr: Sorun bu. Önce daha çok su için.

lines.en: And if it does not stop?
Then take this medicine. One in the morning, one at night.
lines.tr: O zaman bu ilacı alın. Sabah bir, gece bir.

lines.en: How much is it?
Forty. But try the water first. It is free.
lines.tr: Kırk. Ama önce suyu deneyin. Bedava.

questions.q: What is Ilker's problem?
How long has he had it?
What does he drink a lot of?
What does the chemist say to do first?
How does he take the medicine?
options: One in the morning, one at night
questions.note: "One in the morning, one at night."

lines.en: Hello. Are you the new family in number five?
lines.tr: Merhaba. Beş numaradaki yeni aile siz misiniz?

lines.en: Yes. We came on Saturday. I am Deniz.
I am Fatma. I live in number three.
Nice to meet you. Is there a market near here?
lines.tr: Memnun oldum. Buraya yakın bir market var mı?

lines.en: Yes, at the end of the street. It opens at eight.
And the school? We have two children.
The school is behind the park. My son goes there.
lines.tr: Okul parkın arkasında. Oğlum oraya gidiyor.

lines.en: That is very good news.
Come for tea on Sunday. Bring the children.
lines.tr: Pazar günü çaya gelin. Çocukları da getirin.

questions.q: When did Deniz's family come?
Where does Fatma live?
When does the market open?
Where is the school?
options: At the end of the street

questions.q: What does Fatma ask them to do?

lines.en: Excuse me, can you help me? I cannot find my brother.
lines.tr: Affedersiniz, yardım eder misiniz? Kardeşimi bulamıyorum.

lines.en: Do not worry. What is his name?
Efe. He is six years old.
What is he wearing?
A blue shirt and black shoes.
lines.tr: Mavi bir gömlek ve siyah ayakkabı.

lines.en: Where did you see him last?
At the ice cream shop, ten minutes ago.
Look, is that him near the water?
Yes! Efe! Come here now!

questions.q: How old is Efe?
What is he wearing?
options: A blue shirt and black shoes

questions.q: Where did she see him last?
How long ago was that?
Where is Efe?

lines.en: Tuna, what can we give to mother?
A book? She reads every night.
She has too many books. She has no place for them.
lines.tr: Çok fazla kitabı var. Koyacak yeri yok.

lines.en: Then flowers.
Flowers are for one week. I want something better.
lines.tr: Çiçek bir hafta. Daha iyi bir şey istiyorum.

lines.en: She always says she wants a new bag.
lines.tr: Hep yeni bir çanta istediğini söylüyor.

lines.en: That is it! Do you have money?
I have two hundred. And you?
Three hundred. Let us go to the shop after school.
lines.tr: Üç yüz. Okuldan sonra dükkâna gidelim.

questions.q: Why is a book not good?
options: She has no place for more books
questions.note: "She has too many books. She has no place for them."
